name: Mistiora Arte
original_name: ミスティオラ・アーテー
source: A pure-blooded Dark Elf and a high class prostitute who rarely appears in human countries. She is a person of exceptional beauty, high intelligence, culture, and grace. She is cursed with the ability that attracts men, so there is no end to the number of men who want to take possession of Mistiora for themselves. After moving from one country to another, she is now serving as a mistress in the desert kingdom of Eldonia.
